# Project Phoenix v47.0 — Western-Eurasia Alt-History 3: Al-Andalus Resurgent / New Cordoba Exile (1444-1545).
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live `oe_v47_andalus_fortune` -100..+100).
# Supports BOTH Iberian Resurgence (+100) AND the Atlantic Exile Mini-Odyssey to West Africa / Brazil (-100).
# Human-friendly & AI-restrained via `is_ai = no` or future `global_var:oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed`.
# Generated by gen_v470_alt_varna_rus_andalus.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v47_andalus_resurgent = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v47_andalus_resurgent

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1444
		current_year <= 1545
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_andalus_ended }
		OR = {
			country_exists = c:GRA
			location:granada = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { religion ?= religion:sunni }
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = GRA
					tag = MOR
					tag = FEZ
					tag = MAM
					tag = CAS
					tag = ARA
					tag = POR
					tag = SPA
					tag = TUN
					tag = TLE
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							region = region:iberia_region
							region = region:maghreb_region
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			tag = GRA
			tag = MOR
			tag = FEZ
			tag = MAM
			tag = CAS
			tag = ARA
			tag = POR
			tag = SPA
			tag = TUN
			tag = TLE
			tag = MAL
			tag = JOL
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					region = region:iberia_region
					region = region:maghreb_region
					region = region:egypt_region
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Al-Andalus Resurgent — Cordoba & Seville Reclaimed
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_andalus_end_resurgent"
		desc = "oe_v47_andalus_end_resurgent_desc"
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_fortune }
					var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune >= 75
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				AND = {
					location:granada = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { religion ?= religion:sunni } }
					location:cordoba = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { religion ?= religion:sunni } }
					location:sevilla = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { religion ?= religion:sunni } }
				}
			}
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = GRA
						tag = MOR
						tag = MAM
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_resurgent_camp
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 15
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_andalus_caliphate_reborn years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: New Cordoba Exile — Trans-Atlantic Islamic Mini-Odyssey
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_andalus_end_new_cordoba"
		desc = "oe_v47_andalus_end_new_cordoba_desc"
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v47_new_cordoba_founded
			OR = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_fortune }
					var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune <= -65
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				NOT = { location:granada = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { religion ?= religion:sunni } } }
			}
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = GRA
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_exile_camp
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 15
				add_navy_tradition = 10
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_new_cordoba_horizon years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Twilight of the Nasrid Frontier (1545 Horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_andalus_end_iberia_resolved"
		desc = "oe_v47_andalus_end_iberia_resolved_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1545
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_resurgent_camp
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_reconquista_camp
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_exile_camp
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_andalus_frontier_legacy years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune value = 10 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = GRA
					tag = MOR
					tag = FEZ
					tag = MAM
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_resurgent_camp value = 1 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = CAS
					tag = ARA
					tag = POR
					tag = SPA
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_reconquista_camp value = 1 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu1_21_seen }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_21_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu1_ev_cd value = 1 days = 360 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu1.21
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_fortune } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune value = 10 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune < 72
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_alhambra_defiance
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_gibraltar_jihad
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_cordoba_revival
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune add = 0.28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune > -72
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_atlantic_exile_fleet
						has_country_modifier = oe_v47_eu1_mod_santa_hermandad_push
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune add = -0.30 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_andalus_fortune < -100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_fortune value = -100 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_andalus_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_andalus_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_exile_camp }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_andalus_map_exile_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = GRA
						tag = MOR
						tag = FEZ
						tag = MAM
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_resurgent_camp
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_andalus_map_resurgent_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = CAS
						tag = ARA
						tag = POR
						tag = SPA
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_reconquista_camp
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_andalus_map_reconquista_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					area = area:cape_verde_area
					area = area:jolof_area
					area = area:parapitinga_area
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_andalus_map_exile_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_exile_camp }
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = GRA
						tag = MOR
						tag = FEZ
						tag = MAM
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_resurgent_camp
					}
				}
			}
			value = green
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						tag = CAS
						tag = ARA
						tag = POR
						tag = SPA
						has_variable = oe_v47_andalus_reconquista_camp
					}
				}
			}
			value = orange
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					area = area:cape_verde_area
					area = area:jolof_area
					area = area:parapitinga_area
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_andalus_legend_resurgent"
		color = rgb { 48 158 96 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_andalus_legend_reconquista"
		color = rgb { 206 132 52 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_andalus_legend_exile"
		color = rgb { 56 134 198 }
	}
}
